mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.map_layer WHERE code = #{layerCode} AND enabled = true )
SELECT public.get_local_vector_tile( CAST(#{layerCode} AS VARCHAR), CAST(#{z} AS INTEGER), CAST(#{x} AS INTEGER), CAST(#{y} AS INTEGER) ) AS tile
SELECT public.get_local_base_vector_tile( CAST(#{z} AS INTEGER), CAST(#{x} AS INTEGER), CAST(#{y} AS INTEGER) ) AS tile
